title: Craft
body: Every line of code is reviewed. Every pixel justified. We treat 'good enough' as the failure mode it is.

title: Speed
body: Velocity without recklessness. We commit to ship dates and we hit them — because the calendar respects no excuses.

title: Honesty
body: If a feature is a bad idea, you will hear it from us. We are partners, not order-takers.

title: Partnership
body: Your roadmap is our roadmap. We embed, we own outcomes, and we stay long after launch.
